Financial measureAvailable recordsUnavai.prior_paragraph_exact_text: The financial reporting date is 30 September 2026. Year-to-date depreciation covers 1 July to 30 September 2026. Amounts below are in Uganda shillings, rounded to the nearest shilling after the totals are calculated. Only available amounts are added; blank cells and entries marked Pending calculation are not treated as zero. Each record has one unit, so no further quantity multiplier is applied.

Reconciliation of available amountsUGXAv.caption: Table 37: Reconciliation of recorded cost and net book value
Reconciliation of available amountsUGXAv.prior_paragraph_exact_text: The cost, depreciation and net book value totals do not all cover the same records. A direct comparison is possible for 180,730 records classified CAPITALIZED or construction in progress (CIP), where all three amounts are available. Their recorded cost of UGX 760,986,784,838 less accumulated depreciation of UGX 165,185,197,307 gives net book value of UGX 595,801,587,531. For this group, net book value is 78.3% of cost. This is the share of recorded cost that has not been depreciated; it does not measure physical condition, service performance or market value.
